path: within each affected row/col, step size = gcd of gaps between repeated dots; traverse indices congruent to the first dot modulo step
trajectory: paint with the aligned companion color if present on the same modulo-class; otherwise paint with the dot color
dst: fill the line segment between extreme occurrences (or whole line if no companion color)
transform: fill background/marker cells on that path with the trajectory color; ties apply both row and column rules
